name: Shun
source:
A prince from a foreign land, prince Shun was offered to the king and queen at a young age as a means to secure an alliance between the two kingdoms. King Jianyu and queen Lihuan cared for prince Shun as though he was their own flesh and blood, but sometimes he has his doubts.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=37940]official thread[/url]]
